title: Clearing a Pivot from a List of Equations
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, let $p\in V$, and let $P$ be a linear equation in variables indexed by $V$ over the field with two elements. For any finite list of linear equations in these variables, the result of clearing the pivot $p$ from the list is the list obtained by applying the pivot-clearing operation with pivot $p$ and equation $P$ to each row, in the original order.
hypotheses_covered: A pivot variable in the variable type
A pivot linear equation over the field with two elements
A finite list of linear equations over the field with two elements
